title: campylia capillaris
intro: Campylia capillaris, commonly known as the "Wild Marjoram" or "Sweet Marjoram", is a perennial plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It is known for its numerous health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it a popular remedy for digestive issues, stress, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Campylia capillaris include its ability to act as a carminative, antispasmodic, and sedative, helping to soothe digestive discomfort, ease muscle spasms, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Campylia capillaris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
